<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>CivicSync · Municipal Operations Command Center</title>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
  <script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
  <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.1/dist/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

  <style>
    :root {
      --primary: #2563EB;
      --primary-dark: #1D4ED8;
      --primary-light: #EFF6FF;
      --primary-border: #BFDBFE;
      --slate-50: #F8FAFC;
      --slate-100: #F1F5F9;
      --slate-200: #E2E8F0;
      --slate-300: #CBD5E1;
      --slate-400: #94A3B8;
      --slate-500: #64748B;
      --slate-600: #475569;
      --slate-700: #334155;
      --slate-800: #1E293B;
      --slate-900: #0F172A;

      --critical: #DC2626;
      --critical-bg: #FEF2F2;
      --critical-border: #FECACA;
      --high: #EA580C;
      --high-bg: #FFF7ED;
      --high-border: #FFEDD5;
      --medium: #D97706;
      --medium-bg: #FFFBEB;
      --medium-border: #FEF3C7;
      --low: #16A34A;
      --low-bg: #F0FDF4;
      --low-border: #DCFCE7;

      --radius-sm: 6px;
      --radius-md: 10px;
      --radius-lg: 14px;
      --radius-full: 9999px;
      --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08), 0 2px 4px -2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
      --shadow-lg: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 4px 6px -4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
      --shadow-xl: 0 20px 25px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 8px 10px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
    body {
      font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
      background-color: var(--slate-50);
      color: var(--slate-800);
      height: 100vh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    }

    /* TOP GLOBAL HEADER */
    .app-header {
      background: white;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      height: 68px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 0 28px;
      z-index: 100;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .header-left {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 28px;
    }
    .brand-container {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
      text-decoration: none;
      color: inherit;
    }
    .brand-icon {
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1D4ED8 0%, #3B82F6 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
    }
    .brand-name {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .brand-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .live-pulse {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: var(--low-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--low-border);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--low);
    }
    .pulse-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      background: var(--low);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.7);
      animation: pulse 1.8s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(0.95); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.7); }
      70% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0); }
      100% { transform: scale(0.95); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0); }
    }

    /* PRIMARY NAVIGATION TABS */
    .nav-tabs {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      background: var(--slate-100);
      padding: 4px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    }
    .nav-tab-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease-in-out;
    }
    .nav-tab-btn:hover {
      color: var(--slate-900);
    }
    .nav-tab-btn.active {
      background: white;
      color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .tab-counter {
      background: var(--slate-200);
      color: var(--slate-700);
      padding: 1px 7px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .nav-tab-btn.active .tab-counter {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    /* HEADER RIGHT ACTIONS */
    .header-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .city-picker {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: var(--slate-100);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
    }
    .city-picker select {
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--slate-800);
      outline: none;
      margin-left: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .role-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .avatar {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #E0E7FF;
      color: #4338CA;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }
    .role-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .user-name {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .role-title {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .role-select-native {
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      outline: none;
    }

    /* MAIN APP BODY */
    .app-main {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* VIEW PANELS */
    .view-panel {
      display: none;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .view-panel.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    /* ===================================================
       1. TRIAGE QUEUE VIEW
       =================================================== */
    .triage-container {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .triage-sidebar {
      width: 280px;
      background: white;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sidebar-section-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .filter-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .filter-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .filter-item:hover {
      background: var(--slate-100);
      color: var(--slate-900);
    }
    .filter-item.active {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      border-color: var(--primary-border);
      color: var(--primary);
    }
    .filter-item .count {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      background: var(--slate-200);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      color: var(--slate-700);
    }
    .filter-item.active .count {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: white;
    }

    /* QUEUE WORKSPACE */
    .queue-workspace {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--slate-50);
    }
    
    /* KPI METRICS BAR */
    .kpi-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 20px 24px 12px 24px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .kpi-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .kpi-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 4px;
      background: var(--primary);
    }
    .kpi-card.critical::before { background: var(--critical); }
    .kpi-card.high::before { background: var(--high); }
    .kpi-card.sla::before { background: #9333EA; }
    .kpi-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .kpi-label {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    .kpi-value {
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }
    .kpi-trend {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .kpi-trend.positive { color: var(--low); font-weight: 600; }

    /* FAST LANE PROMINENT BANNER */
    .fast-lane-strip {
      margin: 8px 24px 12px 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1E3A8A 0%, #2563EB 100%);
      color: white;
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .fast-lane-text {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .fast-lane-badge {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .fast-lane-btn {
      background: white;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      border: none;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .fast-lane-btn:hover {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* QUEUE FILTER & SEARCH TOOLBAR */
    .queue-toolbar {
      padding: 0 24px 12px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .search-input-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 380px;
    }
    .search-input {
      width: 100%;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      background: white;
      padding: 0 14px 0 38px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s;
    }
    .search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1);
    }
    .search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--slate-400);
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    .toolbar-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .btn-outline {
      height: 40px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--slate-100); }

    /* TICKET CARDS LIST */
    .tickets-scroll-area {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 0 24px 24px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .ticket-row-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      position: relative;
    }
    .ticket-row-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: var(--primary-border);
    }
    .ticket-row-card.active {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2);
    }

    /* DYNAMIC SCORE BADGE */
    .score-box {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-weight: 800;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .score-box .num { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; }
    .score-box .lbl { font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-top: 2px; }
    .score-box.critical { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EF4444 0%, #B91C1C 100%); }
    .score-box.high { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316 0%, #C2410C 100%); }
    .score-box.medium { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F59E0B 0%, #B45309 100%); }
    .score-box.low { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #047857 100%); }

    /* TICKET CONTENT BLOCKS */
    .ticket-main {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .ticket-title-line {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .ticket-id {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      background: var(--slate-100);
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .ticket-hazard-type {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      text-transform: capitalize;
    }
    .status-badge {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .status-badge.reported { background: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; }
    .status-badge.verified { background: #DBEAFE; color: #1E40AF; }
    .status-badge.assigned { background: #E0E7FF; color: #3730A3; }
    .status-badge.resolved { background: #DCFCE7; color: #166534; }
    .status-badge.rejected { background: #FEE2E2; color: #991B1B; }

    .ticket-explanation {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .ticket-meta-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .meta-tag {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    /* RIGHT SLA INDICATOR */
    .ticket-sla-box {
      text-align: right;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 140px;
    }
    .sla-countdown {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .sla-countdown.green { color: var(--low); }
    .sla-countdown.amber { color: var(--medium); }
    .sla-countdown.red { color: var(--critical); }
    .sla-bar-bg {
      width: 120px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .sla-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }
    .sla-bar-fill.green { width: 35%; background: var(--low); }
    .sla-bar-fill.amber { width: 75%; background: var(--medium); }
    .sla-bar-fill.red { width: 100%; background: var(--critical); }

    /* SLIDE-OVER DETAIL DRAWER */
    .detail-drawer {
      width: 480px;
      background: white;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: -4px 0 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    }
    .drawer-header {
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      background: white;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .drawer-title { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--slate-900); }
    .drawer-body {
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .photo-preview-card {
      width: 100%;
      height: 220px;

  <!-- MAIN APPLICATION BODY -->
  <main class="app-main">

    <!-- ========================================================
         VIEW 1: TRIAGE QUEUE & DRAWER

      <div class="triage-container">

        bVal: 0,
        whyRank: "Critical priority: open drain hazard near high-footfall Tajganj market.",

        timeline: [
          { time: "Yesterday 14:10", text: "Reported by Meena" },
          { time: "Today 10:30", text: "Verified by Ward Officer Kavita" }

      },
      {
        id: "TK-103",
        city: "Agra",
        class: "waterlogging",
        extent: "medium",
        score: 62,
        band: "high",
        ward: "AGR-W02",
        location: "Sanjay Place Main Commercial Artery",
        lat: 27.2010,
        lng: 78.0050,
        reporters: 4,
        status: "assigned",
        fastLane: false,
        cVal: 0.50,
        eVal: 0.60,
        kVal: 0.78,
        lVal: "0.90 (Primary Road 30m)",
        bVal: 9,
        whyRank: "High priority: medium waterlogging reported by 4 distinct citizens.",
        photoUrl: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1516214104703-d870798883c5?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
        slaCountdown: "SLA EXCEEDED (120%)",
        slaState: "red",
        slaPercent: 100,
        timeline: [
          { time: "26 Oct 09:00", text: "Reported by citizen" },
          { time: "27 Oct 11:00", text: "Verified and assigned to Deepak (Crew Lead)" }
        ]
      },
      {
        id: "TK-104",
        city: "Jodhpur",
        class: "broken_road",
        extent: "small",
        score: 42,
        band: "medium",
        ward: "JDH-W01",
        location: "Ratanada Residential Lane 4",
        lat: 26.2750,
        lng: 73.0250,
        reporters: 1,
        status: "reported",
        fastLane: false,
        cVal: 0.60,
        eVal: 0.30,
        kVal: 0.65,
        lVal: "0.40 (Residential)",
        bVal: 0,
        whyRank: "Medium priority: small broken road surface in residential lane.",
        photoUrl: "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1578985545062-69928b1d9587?w=600&auto=format&fit=crop&q=60",
        slaCountdown: "11h remaining",
        slaState: "green",
        slaPercent: 20,
        timeline: [
          { time: "Today 11:15", text: "Submitted by citizen" }
        ]
      }
    ];

    let activeNavTab = "triage";
    let selectedTicketId = "TK-101";
    let filterStatus = "all";
    let filterWard = "all";
    let filterClass = "all";
    let filterCity = "all";
    let currentRole = "ward_officer";

    // Navigation Switcher
    function switchNavTab(tabName) {
      activeNavTab = tabName;
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-tab-btn').forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
      event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');

      document.querySelectorAll('.view-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      document.getElementById(`view-${tabName}`).classList.add('active');

      if (tabName === 'map') {
        setTimeout(initOrResizeMap, 100);
      } else if (tabName === 'analytics') {
        setTimeout(initAnalyticsCharts, 100);
      }
    }

    // Render Triage Queue
    function renderQueue() {
      const container = document.getElementById("ticket-list-container");
      container.innerHTML = "";

      const filtered = tickets.filter(t => {
        if (filterCity !== "all" && t.city !== filterCity) return false;
        if (filterStatus !== "all" && t.status !== filterStatus) return false;
        if (filterWard !== "all" && t.ward !== filterWard) return false;
        if (filterClass !== "all" && t.class !== filterClass) return false;
        return true;
      });

      document.getElementById("badge-queue-count").innerText = filtered.length;

      filtered.forEach(t => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = `ticket-row-card ${t.id === selectedTicketId ? 'active' : ''}`;
        card.onclick = () => selectTicket(t.id);

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="score-box ${t.band}">
            <span class="num">${t.score}</span>
            <span class="lbl">${t.band}</span>
          </div>

          <div class="ticket-main">
            <div class="ticket-title-line">
              <span class="ticket-id">${t.id}</span>
              <span class="ticket-hazard-type">${t.class.replace('_', ' ')} (${t.extent})</span>
              <span class="status-badge ${t.status}">${t.status}</span>
              ${t.fastLane ? '<span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:#2563EB; font-weight:700;">⚡ Fast Lane</span>' : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="ticket-explanation">💡 ${t.whyRank}</div>
            <div class="ticket-meta-row">
              <span class="meta-tag">📍 ${t.location} · <strong>${t.ward}</strong></span>
              <span class="meta-tag">👥 ${t.reporters} distinct citizen report${t.reporters > 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="ticket-sla-box">
            <div class="sla-countdown ${t.slaState}">⏱️ ${t.slaCountdown}</div>
            <div class="sla-bar-bg">
              <div class="sla-bar-fill ${t.slaState}" style="width: ${t.slaPercent}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
      });

      renderDrawer();
    }

    // Select and inspect ticket in Drawer
    function selectTicket(id) {
      selectedTicketId = id;
      renderQueue();
    }

    function renderDrawer() {
      const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === selectedTicketId);
      if (!t) return;

      document.getElementById("drawer-ticket-id").innerText = `${t.id} · ${t.class.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}`;
      document.getElementById("drawer-photo").src = t.photoUrl;
      const statusPill = document.getElementById("drawer-status-pill");
      statusPill.innerText = t.status.toUpperCase();
      statusPill.className = `status-badge ${t.status}`;

      document.getElementById("drawer-c").innerText = t.cVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-e").innerText = t.eVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-k").innerText = t.kVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-l").innerText = t.lVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-b").innerText = `+${t.bVal} (${t.reporters} reports)`;
      document.getElementById("drawer-why-text").innerText = `"${t.whyRank}"`;

      // Build Action Buttons
      const actionContainer = document.getElementById("drawer-action-buttons");
      actionContainer.innerHTML = "";

      if (t.status === 'reported') {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn-solid-primary" onclick="transitionTicket('${t.id}', 'verified')">✓ Verify Ticket</button>
          <button class="btn-solid-danger" onclick="promptReject('${t.id}')">✕ Reject</button>
        `;
      } else if (t.status === 'verified') {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn-solid-primary" onclick="transitionTicket('${t.id}', 'assigned')">👷 Assign to Crew</button>
          <button class="btn-solid-danger" onclick="promptReject('${t.id}')">✕ Reject</button>
        `;
      } else if (t.status === 'assigned') {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn-solid-success" onclick="promptResolve('${t.id}')">📸 Resolve (Attach After-Photo)</button>
          <button class="btn-outline" onclick="transitionTicket('${t.id}', 'verified')">Unassign</button>
        `;
      } else {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <div style="grid-column: span 2; font-size:0.85rem; color:#166534; font-weight:700;">
            ✓ Ticket Resolved & Closed. After-photo verified.
          </div>
        `;
      }

      // Render timeline
      const timelineEl = document.getElementById("drawer-timeline");
      timelineEl.innerHTML = t.timeline.map(item => `
        <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:0.82rem;">
          <div style="width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--primary); margin-top:5px;"></div>
          <div>
            <div style="color:var(--slate-800);">${item.text}</div>
            <div style="color:var(--slate-400); font-size:0.72rem;">${item.time}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    // Ticket State Machine Transitions
    function transitionTicket(id, newStatus) {
      const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === id);
      if (t) {
        t.status = newStatus;
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: `Status updated to ${newStatus.toUpperCase()} by ${currentRole}` });
        renderQueue();
      }
    }

    function promptResolve(id) {
      const photo = prompt("Attach after-photo URL (Required before resolving):", "storage/repairs/after_repair_fixed.webp");
      if (photo) {
        const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === id);
        t.status = 'resolved';
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: `Resolved by Deepak (Crew Lead) with verified after-photo: ${photo}` });
        alert(`Success: Ticket ${id} resolved! Citizen will receive a push notification.`);
        renderQueue();
      }
    }

    function promptReject(id) {
      const reason = prompt("Select rejection reason:\n1. not_a_road_hazard\n2. unclear_photo\n3. outside_area\n4. duplicate_merged", "not_a_road_hazard");
      if (reason) {
        const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === id);
        t.status = 'rejected';
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: `Ticket rejected: ${reason}` });
        renderQueue();
      }
    }

    function executeFastLaneBatch() {
      const pendingFast = tickets.filter(t => t.fastLane && t.status === 'reported');
      if (pendingFast.length === 0) {
        alert("No pending Fast Lane tickets in current queue.");
        return;
      }
      pendingFast.forEach(t => {
        t.status = 'verified';
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: "Verified via 1-Click Fast Lane batch action" });
      });
      alert(`Verified ${pendingFast.length} high-confidence tickets instantly!`);
      renderQueue();
    }

    function resolveDuplicate(action, cardId) {
      document.getElementById(cardId).style.opacity = "0.5";
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById(cardId).remove();
        alert(action === 'merge' ? "Reports merged! +3 corroboration bonus added to master ticket." : "Marked as independent distinct hazards.");
      }, 300);
    }

    function setStatusFilter(status) {
      filterStatus = status;
      document.querySelectorAll('.triage-sidebar .filter-list:nth-of-type(1) .filter-item').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
      renderQueue();
    }

    function setWardFilter(ward) {
      filterWard = ward;
      document.querySelectorAll('.triage-sidebar .filter-list:nth-of-type(2) .filter-item').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
      renderQueue();
    }

    function setClassFilter(cls) {
      filterClass = (filterClass === cls) ? 'all' : cls;
      renderQueue();
    }

    function handleCityFilterChange() {
      filterCity = document.getElementById("header-city-filter").value;
      renderQueue();
    }

    function handleRoleSwitch() {
      currentRole = document.getElementById("role-select").value;
      const displayNames = {
        'ward_officer': 'Kavita (Ward Officer)',
        'crew_lead': 'Deepak (Crew Lead)',
        'zonal_engineer': 'Zonal Lead (North)',
        'city_admin': 'Mr. Sharma (City Admin)'
      };
      document.getElementById("user-display-name").innerText = displayNames[currentRole];
      document.getElementById("user-avatar").innerText = displayNames[currentRole][0];
      renderDrawer();
    }

    function handleSearch() {
      const q = document.getElementById("search-box").value.toLowerCase();
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".ticket-row-card");
      cards.forEach(c => {
        const text = c.innerText.toLowerCase();
        c.style.display = text.includes(q) ? "flex" : "none";
      });
    }

    function exportQueueCSV() {
      let csv = "TicketID,City,Ward,HazardClass,Extent,PriorityScore,PriorityBand,Status,Reporters,Location\n";
      tickets.forEach(t => {
        csv += `"${t.id}","${t.city}","${t.ward}","${t.class}","${t.extent}",${t.score},"${t.band}","${t.status}",${t.reporters},"${t.location}"\n`;
      });
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `CivicSync_Tickets_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`;
      a.click();
    }

    // Leaflet GIS Map Init
    let leafletMap = null;
    function initOrResizeMap() {
      if (!leafletMap) {
        leafletMap = L.map('gis-full-map').setView([27.1800, 78.0100], 13);
        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
          attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors'
        }).addTo(leafletMap);

        // ST_SnapToGrid simulated 250m density cells
        const densityCells = [
          { lat: 27.1852, lng: 78.0053, count: 4, color: "#EF4444" },
          { lat: 27.1720, lng: 78.0420, count: 2, color: "#F97316" },
          { lat: 27.2010, lng: 78.0050, count: 3, color: "#EF4444" }
        ];

        densityCells.forEach(cell => {
          L.circle([cell.lat, cell.lng], {
            radius: 200,
            fillColor: cell.color,
            color: cell.color,
            weight: 2,
            opacity: 0.8,
            fillOpacity: 0.35
          }).addTo(leafletMap).bindPopup(`<strong>Density Cell</strong><br>${cell.count} Active Defects`);
        });

        // Add ticket markers
        tickets.forEach(t => {
          L.marker([t.lat, t.lng]).addTo(leafletMap)
            .bindPopup(`<strong>${t.id}: ${t.class.toUpperCase()}</strong><br>${t.location}<br>Score: ${t.score} (${t.band})`);
        });
      } else {
        leafletMap.invalidateSize();
      }
    }

    // Chart.js Analytics Init
    let chartsInitialized = false;
    function initAnalyticsCharts() {
      if (chartsInitialized) return;
      chartsInitialized = true;

      // Class distribution doughnut
      new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-class-distribution'), {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
          labels: ['Potholes', 'Open Drains', 'Waterlogging', 'Broken Road'],
          datasets: [{
            data: [8, 2, 2, 2],
            backgroundColor: ['#2563EB', '#DC2626', '#F59E0B', '#10B981']
          }]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
      });

      // Resolution velocity bar
      new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-resolution-velocity'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'],
          datasets: [
            { label: 'Reported', data: [12, 19, 14, 18, 15, 8], backgroundColor: '#BFDBFE' },
            { label: 'Resolved', data: [8, 14, 12, 16, 14, 7], backgroundColor: '#16A34A' }
          ]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
      });
    }

    // Start App
    renderQueue();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1D4ED8 0%, #3B82F6 100%);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-size: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.3);
    }
    .brand-name {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .brand-subtitle {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .live-pulse {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      background: var(--low-bg);
      border: 1px solid var(--low-border);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--low);
    }
    .pulse-dot {
      width: 7px;
      height: 7px;
      background: var(--low);
      border-radius: 50%;
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.7);
      animation: pulse 1.8s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { transform: scale(0.95); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.7); }
      70% { transform: scale(1); box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(22, 163, 74, 0); }
      100% { transform: scale(0.95); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(22, 163, 74, 0); }
    }

    /* PRIMARY NAVIGATION TABS */
    .nav-tabs {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
      background: var(--slate-100);
      padding: 4px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    }
    .nav-tab-btn {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s ease-in-out;
    }
    .nav-tab-btn:hover {
      color: var(--slate-900);
    }
    .nav-tab-btn.active {
      background: white;
      color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .tab-counter {
      background: var(--slate-200);
      color: var(--slate-700);
      padding: 1px 7px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
    }
    .nav-tab-btn.active .tab-counter {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      color: var(--primary);
    }

    /* HEADER RIGHT ACTIONS */
    .header-right {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
    }
    .city-picker {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      background: var(--slate-100);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
    }
    .city-picker select {
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-weight: 600;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      color: var(--slate-800);
      outline: none;
      margin-left: 6px;
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    .role-pill {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .avatar {
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #E0E7FF;
      color: #4338CA;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }
    .role-info {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
    }
    .user-name {
      font-size: 0.82rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .role-select-native {
      border: none;
      background: transparent;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--primary);
      cursor: pointer;
      outline: none;
    }

    /* MAIN APP BODY */
    .app-main {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    /* VIEW PANELS */
    .view-panel {
      display: none;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .view-panel.active {
      display: flex;
    }

    /* 1. TRIAGE QUEUE VIEW */
    .triage-container {
      display: flex;
      flex: 1;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .triage-sidebar {
      width: 280px;
      background: white;
      border-right: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      padding: 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 24px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .sidebar-section-title {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--slate-400);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }
    .filter-list {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .filter-item {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 9px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      background: transparent;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .filter-item:hover {
      background: var(--slate-100);
      color: var(--slate-900);
    }
    .filter-item.active {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      border-color: var(--primary-border);
      color: var(--primary);
    }
    .filter-item .count {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      background: var(--slate-200);
      padding: 2px 7px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      color: var(--slate-700);
    }
    .filter-item.active .count {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: white;
    }

    /* QUEUE WORKSPACE */
    .queue-workspace {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--slate-50);
    }
    
    /* KPI METRICS BAR */
    .kpi-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 20px 24px 12px 24px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .kpi-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .kpi-card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 4px;
      background: var(--primary);
    }
    .kpi-card.critical::before { background: var(--critical); }
    .kpi-card.high::before { background: var(--high); }
    .kpi-card.sla::before { background: #9333EA; }
    .kpi-header {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      align-items: center;
    }
    .kpi-label {
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    }
    .kpi-value {
      font-size: 1.8rem;
      font-weight: 800;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      line-height: 1.1;
      letter-spacing: -0.03em;
    }
    .kpi-trend {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .kpi-trend.positive { color: var(--low); font-weight: 600; }

    /* FAST LANE PROMINENT BANNER */
    .fast-lane-strip {
      margin: 8px 24px 12px 24px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, #1E3A8A 0%, #2563EB 100%);
      color: white;
      padding: 12px 20px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.25);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .fast-lane-text {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 14px;
    }
    .fast-lane-badge {
      background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
      padding: 4px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .fast-lane-btn {
      background: white;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
      border: none;
      padding: 8px 18px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .fast-lane-btn:hover {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
    }

    /* QUEUE FILTER & SEARCH TOOLBAR */
    .queue-toolbar {
      padding: 0 24px 12px 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .search-input-wrapper {
      position: relative;
      flex: 1;
      max-width: 380px;
    }
    .search-input {
      width: 100%;
      height: 40px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      background: white;
      padding: 0 14px 0 38px;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      outline: none;
      transition: border-color 0.15s;
    }
    .search-input:focus {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.1);
    }
    .search-icon {
      position: absolute;
      left: 12px;
      top: 50%;
      transform: translateY(-50%);
      color: var(--slate-400);
      font-size: 16px;
    }
    .toolbar-actions {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .btn-outline {
      height: 40px;
      padding: 0 14px;
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-700);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .btn-outline:hover { background: var(--slate-100); }

    /* TICKET CARDS LIST */
    .tickets-scroll-area {
      flex: 1;
      overflow-y: auto;
      padding: 0 24px 24px 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .ticket-row-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
      position: relative;
    }
    .ticket-row-card:hover {
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      border-color: var(--primary-border);
    }
    .ticket-row-card.active {
      border-color: var(--primary);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.2);
    }

    /* DYNAMIC SCORE BADGE */
    .score-box {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: white;
      font-weight: 800;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .score-box .num { font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1; }
    .score-box .lbl { font-size: 0.65rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.05em; margin-top: 2px; }
    .score-box.critical { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #EF4444 0%, #B91C1C 100%); }
    .score-box.high { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F97316 0%, #C2410C 100%); }
    .score-box.medium { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #F59E0B 0%, #B45309 100%); }
    .score-box.low { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981 0%, #047857 100%); }

    /* TICKET CONTENT BLOCKS */
    .ticket-main {
      flex: 1;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .ticket-title-line {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .ticket-id {
      font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      background: var(--slate-100);
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }
    .ticket-hazard-type {
      font-size: 1.05rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--slate-900);
      text-transform: capitalize;
    }
    .status-badge {
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      padding: 3px 10px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .status-badge.reported { background: #FEF3C7; color: #92400E; }
    .status-badge.verified { background: #DBEAFE; color: #1E40AF; }
    .status-badge.assigned { background: #E0E7FF; color: #3730A3; }
    .status-badge.resolved { background: #DCFCE7; color: #166534; }
    .status-badge.rejected { background: #FEE2E2; color: #991B1B; }

    .ticket-explanation {
      font-size: 0.88rem;
      color: var(--slate-600);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .ticket-meta-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 20px;
      font-size: 0.78rem;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      margin-top: 2px;
    }
    .meta-tag {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }

    /* RIGHT SLA INDICATOR */
    .ticket-sla-box {
      text-align: right;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 6px;
      min-width: 140px;
    }
    .sla-countdown {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
    }
    .sla-countdown.green { color: var(--low); }
    .sla-countdown.amber { color: var(--medium); }
    .sla-countdown.red { color: var(--critical); }
    .sla-bar-bg {
      width: 120px;
      height: 6px;
      background: var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .sla-bar-fill {
      height: 100%;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
    }
    .sla-bar-fill.green { width: 35%; background: var(--low); }
    .sla-bar-fill.amber { width: 75%; background: var(--medium); }
    .sla-bar-fill.red { width: 100%; background: var(--critical); }

    /* SLIDE-OVER DETAIL DRAWER */
    .detail-drawer {
      width: 480px;
      background: white;
      border-left: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      overflow-y: auto;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: -4px 0 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
    }
    .drawer-header {
      padding: 20px 24px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      position: sticky;
      top: 0;
      background: white;
      z-index: 10;
    }
    .drawer-title { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--slate-900); }
    .drawer-body {
      padding: 24px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 20px;
    }
    .photo-preview-card {
      width: 100%;
      height: 220px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      background: var(--slate-800);
    }
    .photo-preview-card img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      object-fit: cover;
    }
    .privacy-shield-tag {
      position: absolute;
      top: 12px;
      right: 12px;
      background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.85);
      backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
      color: #4ADE80;
      padding: 5px 12px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      font-size: 0.72rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      border: 1px solid rgba(74, 222, 128, 0.3);
    }
    
    .formula-breakdown-card {
      background: var(--slate-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px;
    }
    .formula-title {
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--slate-500);
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }
    .formula-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
      font-size: 0.82rem;
    }
    .formula-cell {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 6px 10px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
    }
    .formula-cell .val { font-weight: 700; color: var(--slate-900); }

    .action-panel-card {
      background: var(--primary-light);
      border: 1px solid var(--primary-border);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 18px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }
    .action-panel-title {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--primary-dark);
    }
    .btn-group-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .btn-solid-primary {
      background: var(--primary);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }
    .btn-solid-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark); }
    .btn-solid-success {
      background: var(--low);
      color: white;
      border: none;
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .btn-solid-danger {
      background: white;
      color: var(--critical);
      border: 1px solid var(--critical-border);
      padding: 10px 16px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      cursor: pointer;
    }

    /* 2. FULL-SCREEN GIS DENSITY MAP VIEW */
    .map-view-container {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      position: relative;
    }
    #gis-full-map {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
    }
    .map-floating-panel {
      position: absolute;
      top: 20px;
      left: 20px;
      background: white;
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 16px 20px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      z-index: 1000;
      max-width: 320px;
    }
    .map-floating-panel h3 { font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--slate-900); }
    .map-floating-panel p { font-size: 0.78rem; color: var(--slate-500); margin-top: 4px; }
    .map-legend { margin-top: 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 0.75rem; }
    .legend-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .legend-box { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 3px; }

    /* 3. DUPLICATE RESOLUTION HUB */
    .duplicate-hub {
      padding: 28px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      max-width: 1100px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .hub-header { margin-bottom: 24px; }
    .hub-header h2 { font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--slate-900); }
    .hub-header p { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--slate-500); margin-top: 4px; }
    .dup-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
      padding: 24px;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }
    .dup-comparison-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
      gap: 20px;
      align-items: center;
      margin: 20px 0;
    }
    .dup-side-box {
      background: var(--slate-50);
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      padding: 16px;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 10px;
    }
    .dup-side-box img {
      width: 100%;
      height: 160px;
      object-fit: cover;
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    }
    .dup-vs-divider {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }
    .distance-pill {
      background: #FEF3C7;
      color: #B45309;
      font-weight: 800;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-full);
      border: 1px solid #FDE68A;
    }

    /* 4. SLA ESCALATION MONITOR */
    .sla-view-container {
      padding: 28px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      max-width: 1200px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      width: 100%;
    }
    .sla-table-card {
      background: white;
      border: 1px solid var(--slate-200);

      container.innerHTML = "";

      const filtered = tickets.filter(t => {
        if (filterCity !== "all" && t.city !== filterCity) return false;
        if (filterStatus !== "all" && t.status !== filterStatus) return false;
        if (filterWard !== "all" && t.ward !== filterWard) return false;
        if (filterClass !== "all" && t.class !== filterClass) return false;
        return true;
      });

      document.getElementById("badge-queue-count").innerText = filtered.length;

      filtered.forEach(t => {
        const card = document.createElement("div");
        card.className = `ticket-row-card ${t.id === selectedTicketId ? 'active' : ''}`;
        card.onclick = () => selectTicket(t.id);

        card.innerHTML = `
          <div class="score-box ${t.band}">
            <span class="num">${t.score}</span>
            <span class="lbl">${t.band}</span>
          </div>

          <div class="ticket-main">
            <div class="ticket-title-line">
              <span class="ticket-id">${t.id}</span>
              <span class="ticket-hazard-type">${t.class.replace('_', ' ')} (${t.extent})</span>
              <span class="status-badge ${t.status}">${t.status}</span>
              ${t.fastLane ? '<span style="font-size:0.75rem; color:#2563EB; font-weight:700;">⚡ Fast Lane</span>' : ''}
            </div>
            <div class="ticket-explanation">💡 ${t.whyRank}</div>
            <div class="ticket-meta-row">
              <span class="meta-tag">📍 ${t.location} · <strong>${t.ward}</strong></span>
              <span class="meta-tag">👥 ${t.reporters} distinct citizen report${t.reporters > 1 ? 's' : ''}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div class="ticket-sla-box">
            <div class="sla-countdown ${t.slaState}">⏱️ ${t.slaCountdown}</div>
            <div class="sla-bar-bg">
              <div class="sla-bar-fill ${t.slaState}" style="width: ${t.slaPercent}%;"></div>
            </div>
          </div>
        `;
        container.appendChild(card);
      });

      renderDrawer();
    }

    function selectTicket(id) {
      selectedTicketId = id;
      renderQueue();
    }

    function renderDrawer() {
      const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === selectedTicketId);
      if (!t) return;

      document.getElementById("drawer-ticket-id").innerText = `${t.id} · ${t.class.replace('_', ' ').toUpperCase()}`;
      document.getElementById("drawer-photo").src = t.photoUrl;
      const statusPill = document.getElementById("drawer-status-pill");
      statusPill.innerText = t.status.toUpperCase();
      statusPill.className = `status-badge ${t.status}`;

      document.getElementById("drawer-c").innerText = t.cVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-e").innerText = t.eVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-k").innerText = t.kVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-l").innerText = t.lVal;
      document.getElementById("drawer-b").innerText = `+${t.bVal} (${t.reporters} reports)`;
      document.getElementById("drawer-why-text").innerText = `"${t.whyRank}"`;

      const actionContainer = document.getElementById("drawer-action-buttons");
      actionContainer.innerHTML = "";

      if (t.status === 'reported') {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn-solid-primary" onclick="transitionTicket('${t.id}', 'verified')">✓ Verify Ticket</button>
          <button class="btn-solid-danger" onclick="promptReject('${t.id}')">✕ Reject</button>
        `;
      } else if (t.status === 'verified') {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn-solid-primary" onclick="transitionTicket('${t.id}', 'assigned')">👷 Assign to Crew</button>
          <button class="btn-solid-danger" onclick="promptReject('${t.id}')">✕ Reject</button>
        `;
      } else if (t.status === 'assigned') {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <button class="btn-solid-success" onclick="promptResolve('${t.id}')">📸 Resolve (Attach After-Photo)</button>
          <button class="btn-outline" onclick="transitionTicket('${t.id}', 'verified')">Unassign</button>
        `;
      } else {
        actionContainer.innerHTML = `
          <div style="grid-column: span 2; font-size:0.85rem; color:#166534; font-weight:700;">
            ✓ Ticket Resolved & Closed. After-photo verified.
          </div>
        `;
      }

      const timelineEl = document.getElementById("drawer-timeline");
      timelineEl.innerHTML = t.timeline.map(item => `
        <div style="display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:0.82rem;">
          <div style="width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--primary); margin-top:5px;"></div>
          <div>
            <div style="color:var(--slate-800);">${item.text}</div>
            <div style="color:var(--slate-400); font-size:0.72rem;">${item.time}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `).join('');
    }

    function transitionTicket(id, newStatus) {
      const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === id);
      if (t) {
        t.status = newStatus;
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: `Status updated to ${newStatus.toUpperCase()} by ${currentRole}` });
        renderQueue();
      }
    }

    function promptResolve(id) {
      const photo = prompt("Attach after-photo URL (Required before resolving):", "storage/repairs/after_repair_fixed.webp");
      if (photo) {
        const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === id);
        t.status = 'resolved';
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: `Resolved by Deepak (Crew Lead) with verified after-photo: ${photo}` });
        alert(`Success: Ticket ${id} resolved! Citizen will receive a push notification.`);
        renderQueue();
      }
    }

    function promptReject(id) {
      const reason = prompt("Select rejection reason:\n1. not_a_road_hazard\n2. unclear_photo\n3. outside_area\n4. duplicate_merged", "not_a_road_hazard");
      if (reason) {
        const t = tickets.find(i => i.id === id);
        t.status = 'rejected';
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: `Ticket rejected: ${reason}` });
        renderQueue();
      }
    }

    function executeFastLaneBatch() {
      const pendingFast = tickets.filter(t => t.fastLane && t.status === 'reported');
      if (pendingFast.length === 0) {
        alert("No pending Fast Lane tickets in current queue.");
        return;
      }
      pendingFast.forEach(t => {
        t.status = 'verified';
        t.timeline.unshift({ time: "Just now", text: "Verified via 1-Click Fast Lane batch action" });
      });
      alert(`Verified ${pendingFast.length} high-confidence tickets instantly!`);
      renderQueue();
    }

    function resolveDuplicate(action, cardId) {
      document.getElementById(cardId).style.opacity = "0.5";
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById(cardId).remove();
        alert(action === 'merge' ? "Reports merged! +3 corroboration bonus added to master ticket." : "Marked as independent distinct hazards.");
      }, 300);
    }

    function setStatusFilter(status) {
      filterStatus = status;
      document.querySelectorAll('.triage-sidebar .filter-list:nth-of-type(1) .filter-item').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
      renderQueue();
    }

    function setWardFilter(ward) {
      filterWard = ward;
      document.querySelectorAll('.triage-sidebar .filter-list:nth-of-type(2) .filter-item').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
      event.currentTarget.classList.add('active');
      renderQueue();
    }

    function setClassFilter(cls) {
      filterClass = (filterClass === cls) ? 'all' : cls;
      renderQueue();
    }

    function handleCityFilterChange() {
      filterCity = document.getElementById("header-city-filter").value;
      renderQueue();
    }

    function handleRoleSwitch() {
      currentRole = document.getElementById("role-select").value;
      const displayNames = {
        'ward_officer': 'Kavita (Ward Officer)',
        'crew_lead': 'Deepak (Crew Lead)',
        'zonal_engineer': 'Zonal Lead (North)',
        'city_admin': 'Mr. Sharma (City Admin)'
      };
      document.getElementById("user-display-name").innerText = displayNames[currentRole];
      document.getElementById("user-avatar").innerText = displayNames[currentRole][0];
      renderDrawer();
    }

    function handleSearch() {
      const q = document.getElementById("search-box").value.toLowerCase();
      const cards = document.querySelectorAll(".ticket-row-card");
      cards.forEach(c => {
        const text = c.innerText.toLowerCase();
        c.style.display = text.includes(q) ? "flex" : "none";
      });
    }

    function exportQueueCSV() {
      let csv = "TicketID,City,Ward,HazardClass,Extent,PriorityScore,PriorityBand,Status,Reporters,Location\n";
      tickets.forEach(t => {
        csv += `"${t.id}","${t.city}","${t.ward}","${t.class}","${t.extent}",${t.score},"${t.band}","${t.status}",${t.reporters},"${t.location}"\n`;
      });
      const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv" });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement("a");
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `CivicSync_Tickets_${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.csv`;
      a.click();
    }

    let leafletMap = null;
    function initOrResizeMap() {
      if (!leafletMap) {
        leafletMap = L.map('gis-full-map').setView([27.1800, 78.0100], 13);
        L.tileLayer('https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png', {
          attribution: '© OpenStreetMap contributors'
        }).addTo(leafletMap);

        const densityCells = [
          { lat: 27.1852, lng: 78.0053, count: 4, color: "#EF4444" },
          { lat: 27.1720, lng: 78.0420, count: 2, color: "#F97316" },
          { lat: 27.2010, lng: 78.0050, count: 3, color: "#EF4444" }
        ];

        densityCells.forEach(cell => {
          L.circle([cell.lat, cell.lng], {
            radius: 200,
            fillColor: cell.color,
            color: cell.color,
            weight: 2,
            opacity: 0.8,
            fillOpacity: 0.35
          }).addTo(leafletMap).bindPopup(`<strong>Density Cell</strong><br>${cell.count} Active Defects`);
        });

        tickets.forEach(t => {
          L.marker([t.lat, t.lng]).addTo(leafletMap)
            .bindPopup(`<strong>${t.id}: ${t.class.toUpperCase()}</strong><br>${t.location}<br>Score: ${t.score} (${t.band})`);
        });
      } else {
        leafletMap.invalidateSize();
      }
    }

    let chartsInitialized = false;
    function initAnalyticsCharts() {
      if (chartsInitialized) return;
      chartsInitialized = true;

      new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-class-distribution'), {
        type: 'doughnut',
        data: {
          labels: ['Potholes', 'Open Drains', 'Waterlogging', 'Broken Road'],
          datasets: [{
            data: [8, 2, 2, 2],
            backgroundColor: ['#2563EB', '#DC2626', '#F59E0B', '#10B981']
          }]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
      });

      new Chart(document.getElementById('chart-resolution-velocity'), {
        type: 'bar',
        data: {
          labels: ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat'],
          datasets: [
            { label: 'Reported', data: [12, 19, 14, 18, 15, 8], backgroundColor: '#BFDBFE' },
            { label: 'Resolved', data: [8, 14, 12, 16, 14, 7], backgroundColor: '#16A34A' }
          ]
        },
        options: { responsive: true, plugins: { legend: { position: 'bottom' } } }
      });
    }

    renderQueue();
  </script>
</body>
</html>
